howto: Nov 12 (v6): write files sim.py, cards.py, test.py and deck.json to one folder and run: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python3 test.py 5000. deck.json is the 99-card list as of deck v51. Paired-seed design: the same shuffles for every deck version. Older scripts (b4.py, combo.py, creatures.py, run.py) were written for v5 and expect old file paths.
modeled: Nov 12 rebuild, Oracle-checked against the whatwhatmeow/mtg-data repo (Scryfall data, 2026-11-12). Fixes: Jace, Wielder of Mysteries {1}{U}{U}{U} (was 6 mana); Bone Miser {4}{B} (was {2}{B}{B}); Currency Converter {1} (was {2}), and its {2},T loot is now modeled; Cephalid Coliseum makes only you draw/discard 3 (it is 'target player'; it was modeled as each player; set COLISEUM_EACH_PLAYER=True to reproduce the old model). New: Riverglide Pathway, Hidden Lair, Graven Cairns, Capital City (filter + cycling {2}), Desolate Lighthouse ({1}{U}{R},T loot), Howling Mine, Echo of Eons (no discard, flashback {2}{U}), realistic opponent hands (dump 0-1 extra card per turn through turn 5). Also modeled: Doom drain per land-discard event (x copies x Doom Variant/Roaming Throne), outlets, wheels with Notion Thief/Narset/Insight/Bowmasters, Dakmor dredge, Oscorp mayhem, Hideout, Petrified Field, Geier Reach, land ETB conditions, Living Laser/Norman/Green Goblin/Frog combat, Loki draws, Shredder connive, copies, Muddle/Perplex/Shred Memory transmute, tutors, counters against opponent removal and wipes.
name: Doctor Doom deck simulator
not_modeled: Norman's Green Goblin back face (mayhem for every nonland card in your graveyard: recast discarded wheels), Currency Converter's exile/Treasure half, Archfiend cycling, Faithless Looting flashback, Bone Miser zombies, Library of Leng put-on-top, Bracket 4-only cards (still in v5 sim.py), opponents attacking or comboing, removal you cast, painland life, Spymaster's Vault connive.
